A '''glowbulb''' was a device which could wink out when overloaded. When he was nearly shot down in battle due to the reprogrammed [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] on [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson's]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] felt that he would have winked out like one of these if not for a warning from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Shadows">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
